title: Use Seedance 2.5 T2V with Duration: 30 seconds and Format: 16:9 when targeting…
content:
Use Seedance 2.5 T2V with Duration: 30 seconds and Format: 16:9 when targeting a long single-shot “oner” sequence.

To enforce a true oner, explicitly prompt One continuous unbroken 30-second Steadicam shot; no cuts, transitions, montage, teleportation or camera resets.

Maintain coherent motion by specifying The camera constantly travels forward through the transformation, changing composition organically as objects pass near the lens.

Improve long-form consistency by adding continuity constraints in the prompt (preserve one character/prop/location layout, mechanically coherent transformation, continuous screen direction/spatial geography, and forbid duplicates/wardrobe changes/illegible text/gore/unexplained morphing).

For complex 30s narratives, structure the prompt as timestamped visual beats (e.g., 0.0–1.2s, 1.2–2.4s, etc.) to guide pacing and ensure each action happens in order.

To keep transformations believable, require that every component originates visibly from the source object/environment and transforms via physically connected mechanics (no unexplained morphing).

If you need audio continuity, include a sound design line describing continuous room tone that evolves with specific diegetic elements and cues (rumble, beeps, chimes, announcements) aligned to the action.

es.content:
Usa Seedance 2.5 T2V con Duration: 30 seconds y Format: 16:9 cuando apuntes a una secuencia larga de una sola toma, tipo “oner”.

Para imponer un verdadero oner, indica explícitamente One continuous unbroken 30-second Steadicam shot; no cuts, transitions, montage, teleportation or camera resets.

Mantén un movimiento coherente especificando The camera constantly travels forward through the transformation, changing composition organically as objects pass near the lens.

Mejora la consistencia en formatos largos añadiendo restricciones de continuidad en el prompt (preserve one character/prop/location layout, mechanically coherent transformation, continuous screen direction/spatial geography, and forbid duplicates/wardrobe changes/illegible text/gore/unexplained morphing).

Para narrativas complejas de 30 s, estructura el prompt como visual beats con marcas de tiempo (por ejemplo, 0.0–1.2s, 1.2–2.4s, etc.) para guiar el ritmo y asegurar que cada acción ocurra en orden.

Para que las transformaciones resulten creíbles, exige que cada componente se origine visiblemente a partir del objeto o entorno fuente y se transforme mediante mecánicas físicamente conectadas (no unexplained morphing).

Si necesitas continuidad de audio, incluye una línea de sound design que describa un room tone continuo que evoluciona con elementos y señales diegéticas específicas (rumble, beeps, chimes, announcements) alineadas con la acción.

fr.content:
Utilisez Seedance 2.5 T2V avec une durée de 30 secondes et un format 16:9 lorsque vous ciblez une séquence longue en plan-séquence unique (« oner »).

Pour imposer un véritable oner, formulez explicitement le prompt ainsi : One continuous unbroken 30-second Steadicam shot; no cuts, transitions, montage, teleportation or camera resets.

Maintenez une motion cohérente en précisant : The camera constantly travels forward through the transformation, changing composition organically as objects pass near the lens.

Améliorez la cohérence sur la durée en ajoutant des contraintes de continuité dans le prompt (préserver la disposition d’un seul personnage/objet/lieu, transformation mécaniquement cohérente, direction d’écran et géographie spatiale continues, et interdire les doublons/changements de tenue/texte illisible/gore/morphing inexpliqué).

Pour des récits complexes de 30 s, structurez le prompt sous forme de beats visuels horodatés (par ex. 0.0–1.2s, 1.2–2.4s, etc.) afin de guider le rythme et de garantir que chaque action se déroule dans l’ordre.

Pour que les transformations restent crédibles, exigez que chaque composant provienne visiblement de l’objet ou de l’environnement source et se transforme via des mécanismes physiquement connectés (no unexplained morphing).

Si vous avez besoin d’une continuité audio, ajoutez une ligne de sound design décrivant un room tone continu qui évolue avec des éléments et des indices diégétiques spécifiques (rumble, beeps, chimes, announcements) synchronisés avec l’action.

ja.content:
Seedance 2.5 T2V を、長尺のワンショット「oner」シーケンスを狙う場合は Duration: 30 seconds、Format: 16:9 で使用してください。

真の oner を徹底するには、One continuous unbroken 30-second Steadicam shot; no cuts, transitions, montage, teleportation or camera resets. と明示的に prompt してください。

動きの一貫性を保つには、The camera constantly travels forward through the transformation, changing composition organically as objects pass near the lens. と指定してください。

長尺の整合性を高めるには、prompt に continuity constraints を追加します（1人のキャラクター／小道具／ロケーションの配置を維持する、機械的に整合した変形、連続した画面方向／空間的地理、重複／衣装変更／判読不能なテキスト／gore／説明のない morphing を禁止する）。

複雑な 30 秒の narrative では、prompt をタイムスタンプ付きの visual beats（例: 0.0–1.2s、1.2–2.4s など）として構成し、テンポを導き、各アクションが順番に起こるようにします。

変形をより信頼できるものにするには、すべての要素がソースとなる object/environment から視覚的に発生し、物理的に接続された mechanics を通じて変化するように指定します（説明のない morphing は不可）。

音声の一貫性が必要な場合は、アクションに合わせて、特定の diegetic elements と cues（rumble、beeps、chimes、announcements）とともに変化していく continuous room tone を説明する sound design line を含めてください。

ko.content:
Seedance 2.5 T2V를 사용할 때, 긴 단일 샷 “oner” 시퀀스를 목표로 한다면 Duration: 30 seconds와 Format: 16:9를 사용하세요.

진정한 oner를 강제하려면, One continuous unbroken 30-second Steadicam shot; no cuts, transitions, montage, teleportation or camera resets.라고 명시적으로 prompt하세요.

The camera constantly travels forward through the transformation, changing composition organically as objects pass near the lens.라고 지정해 모션의 일관성을 유지하세요.

prompt에 continuity constraints를 추가해 장편 일관성을 높이세요(한 캐릭터/소품/장소의 배치 유지, 기계적으로 일관된 변형, continuous screen direction/spatial geography, 그리고 duplicates/wardrobe changes/illegible text/gore/unexplained morphing 금지).

복잡한 30초 내러티브의 경우, prompt를 timestamped visual beats(예: 0.0–1.2s, 1.2–2.4s 등)로 구성해 페이싱을 유도하고 각 동작이 순서대로 일어나도록 하세요.

변형을 더 그럴듯하게 보이게 하려면, 모든 구성 요소가 source object/environment에서 눈에 보이게 기원하며 물리적으로 연결된 메커니즘을 통해 변형되도록 요구하세요(no unexplained morphing).

오디오의 연속성이 필요하다면, continuous room tone이 특정 diegetic elements와 cues(rumble, beeps, chimes, announcements)에 따라 변화하며 동작과 맞물리도록 설명하는 sound design line을 포함하세요.

pt.content:
Use Seedance 2.5 T2V com Duration: 30 seconds e Format: 16:9 ao buscar uma sequência longa em plano-sequência (“oner”).

Para garantir um verdadeiro oner, especifique explicitamente no prompt: One continuous unbroken 30-second Steadicam shot; no cuts, transitions, montage, teleportation or camera resets.

Mantenha o movimento coerente especificando: The camera constantly travels forward through the transformation, changing composition organically as objects pass near the lens.

Melhore a consistência em long-form adicionando restrições de continuidade no prompt (preserve one character/prop/location layout, mechanically coherent transformation, continuous screen direction/spatial geography, and forbid duplicates/wardrobe changes/illegible text/gore/unexplained morphing).

Para narrativas complexas de 30s, estruture o prompt como beats visuais com timestamp (por exemplo, 0.0–1.2s, 1.2–2.4s, etc.) para orientar o ritmo e garantir que cada ação aconteça em ordem.

Para manter as transformações críveis, exija que cada componente se origine visivelmente do objeto/ambiente de origem e se transforme por meio de mecânicas fisicamente conectadas (no unexplained morphing).

Se precisar de continuidade de áudio, inclua uma linha de sound design descrevendo continuous room tone que evolui com elementos e cues diegéticos específicos (rumble, beeps, chimes, announcements) alinhados à ação.

zh.content:
在针对长篇单镜头“oner”序列时，请使用 Seedance 2.5 T2V，时长设为 30 秒，格式设为 16:9。

为了强制实现真正的 oner，请明确提示：One continuous unbroken 30-second Steadicam shot; no cuts, transitions, montage, teleportation or camera resets.

通过指定 The camera constantly travels forward through the transformation, changing composition organically as objects pass near the lens. 来保持运动连贯性。

通过在 prompt 中加入连续性约束来提升长篇一致性（保留单一角色/道具/场景布局，机械上连贯的变形，持续一致的屏幕方向/空间地理关系，并禁止重复出现、服装变化、不可辨认的文字、血腥内容、无法解释的形变）。

对于复杂的 30 秒叙事，将 prompt 结构化为带时间戳的视觉节拍（例如 0.0–1.2s、1.2–2.4s 等），以引导节奏并确保每个动作按顺序发生。

为了让变形更可信，请要求每个组成部分都必须清晰地源自原始物体/环境，并通过物理连接的机械方式完成变形（no unexplained morphing）。

如果你需要音频连续性，请加入一行 sound design，描述持续的 room tone 如何随着特定的 diegetic 元素和提示音（rumble、beeps、chimes、announcements）演变，并与动作保持同步。
